## Recovered observations

40 points (from FA-39) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b3`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Average of several tests (no unused statement); 95 percent limits 66.6 and 69.0 at Dr 0 and 88.1 and 92.3 at Dr 1.0. Supplies the 67.8 minimum that F2-17 leaves unlabeled. Reprinted under soil 11 (FA-43).
- Codex: Unit weights are mean minimum;maximum. Average of several tests with 95% confidence limits; sample identities missing. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-39, printed A-77, PDF 78
